# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| system-match-record | `assets/standard-system-entry.md`, filled | `dept-decision-rights`, `mi-equipment`, (order, connect) | Every field set or marked missing: request and plant, machine class, route and status with its source, candidate kit or "no standard system", cost-template inputs, Cyber Security status, next step |
| cost-template-inputs | Section of the system match record | `dept-decision-rights`, approved by the plant budget owner | Inputs given or marked missing; No kit price or lead time quoted unless it is in the kit list |
| no-standard-system-statement | Section of the system match record | `invest-screen`, then Lane 3 (3b) | Route is TODO, stub or absent in the validated routes; The record says so and names Lane 3 as the next step |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `catalog-usecase`
- **Next:** step 1b2 dept-decision-rights (cost template and approval), step 1b3 mi-equipment (order and connect), step 1b4 ops-analytics-asset (apply template and go live); acceptance by deploy-acceptance.: `dept-decision-rights`, `mi-equipment`, `ops-analytics-asset`, `deploy-acceptance`
- **Next:** With no standard system: invest-screen and Lane 3 (3b).: `invest-screen`
- **Stops here when:** the route is not written in full, the tool boundary is not met, or the tool has no named operations owner and support level
- **Stops here when:** A security-relevant connection also goes to deploy-cybersec, and Cyber Security sign-off stays human
- **Stops here when:** Do not offer a non-standard system
